text_en: and do not become an enemy instead of a friend; for a bad name incurs shame and reproach; so it is with the double-tongued sinner.
text_cn: 不要因言语不慎，将友谊变成仇恨；因为，有恶名的人，必蒙羞受辱；一口两舌的罪人，也是如此。

text_en: Do not fall into the grip of passion, or you may be torn apart as by a bull.
text_cn: 不要放纵你的情欲，免得你的情欲，因了糊涂，像牛犊一样，消耗你的气力；

text_en: Your leaves will be devoured and your fruit destroyed, and you will be left like a withered tree.
text_cn: 吃尽你的叶子，摧残你的果实，抛弃你，如同一棵旷野里的枯树。

text_en: Evil passion destroys those who have it, and makes them the laughingstock of their enemies.
text_cn: 邪恶的情欲，要灭绝怀有情欲的人，使他成为仇人的话柄，使他的命运与不虔敬者相同。

text_en: Pleasant speech multiplies friends, and a gracious tongue multiplies courtesies.
text_cn: 亲切温柔的言语，能使友人增多，并能感化仇人；同情的话，能使友好的往来敦厚。

text_en: Let those who are friendly with you be many, but let your advisers be one in a thousand.
text_cn: 与你要好的人应多，然而作你参谋的，只千中取一。

text_en: When you gain friends, gain them through testing, and do not trust them hastily.
text_cn: 如要交友，先要考验，不要立刻信任他。

text_en: For there are friends who are such when it suits them, but they will not stand by you in time of trouble.
text_cn: 因为有的人，只是一时的朋友；在你困难的日子，就不见了。

text_en: And there are friends who change into enemies, and tell of the quarrel to your disgrace.
text_cn: 有的朋友，一旦变成仇人，就把你争执的事和仇恨，泄漏出来，为凌辱你。

text_en: And there are friends who sit at your table, but they will not stand by you in time of trouble.
text_cn: 有的人是酒肉朋友，在你困难的日子，就不见了。

text_en: When you are prosperous, they become your second self, and lord it over your servants;
text_cn: 你幸福的时候，他和你同心，对你的仆婢，也任意使唤；

text_en: but if you are brought low, they turn against you, and hide themselves from you.
text_cn: 若你遭了难，他就翻脸攻击你，回避你。但对于良好的友谊，你应恒一不变。

text_en: Keep away from your enemies, and be on guard with your friends.
text_cn: 你当远离你的仇人，慎重对待你的朋友。

text_en: Faithful friends are a sturdy shelter: whoever finds one has found a treasure.
text_cn: 忠实的朋友，是稳固的保障；谁寻得了他，就是寻得了宝藏。

text_en: Faithful friends are beyond price; no amount can balance their worth.
text_cn: 忠实的朋友，是无价之宝，他的高贵无法衡量：金银也比不上他忠实的美好。

text_en: Faithful friends are life-saving medicine; and those who fear the Lord will find them.
text_cn: 忠实的朋友，是生命和不死的妙药；惟有敬畏上主的人，才能寻得。

text_en: Those who fear the Lord direct their friendship aright, for as they are, so are their neighbors also.
text_cn: 敬畏上主的人，才有真正的友谊，因为他怎样，他的朋友也怎样。

text_en: My child, from your youth choose discipline, and when you have gray hair you will still find wisdom.
text_cn: 我儿，从你幼年时起，就应接受教训；如此，直到老年，必能寻得智慧。

text_en: Come to her like one who plows and sows, and wait for her good harvest. For when you cultivate her you will toil but little, and soon you will eat of her produce.
text_cn: 你要亲近她，就如耕田和播种的人，等待她的美果；

text_en: She seems very harsh to the undisciplined; fools cannot remain with her.
text_cn: 因为，你用智慧去工作，用功不久，很快就可吃她的出产。

text_en: She will be like a heavy stone to test them, and they will not delay in casting her aside.
text_cn: 智慧为不肯受教的人，是酸苦的；愚昧的人，不会与智慧常久相处，

text_en: For wisdom is like her name; she is not readily perceived by many.
text_cn: 因为，智慧有如放在愚昧人身上的重石，他决不会迟延抛弃她。

text_en: Listen, my child, and accept my judgment; do not reject my counsel.
text_cn: 原来智慧的含义，正如她的名字，明白的人不多。 但认识她的人，她必与他相处，直到天主面前。

text_en: Put your feet into her fetters, and your neck into her collar.
text_cn: 我儿，你当听取和接受我的智谋，不要拒绝我的忠告。

text_en: Bend your shoulders and carry her, and do not fret under her bonds.
text_cn: 把她的脚镣扣在你脚上，将她的枷锁套在你的颈上。

text_en: Come to her with all your soul, and keep her ways with all your might.
text_cn: 要放低你的肩膀，肩起她来，不要因她的束缚而烦恼。

text_en: Search out and seek, and she will become known to you; and when you get hold of her, do not let her go.
text_cn: 要全心亲近她，全力遵循她的道路。

text_en: For at last you will find the rest she gives, and she will be changed into joy for you.
text_cn: 要研究她，寻求她，她必把自己显示给你；你一得了她，总不要离弃她；

text_en: Then her fetters will become for you a strong defense, and her collar a glorious robe.
text_cn: 因为，你终究要在她内寻着平安，她必变成你的喜乐。

text_en: Her yoke is a golden ornament, and her bonds a purple cord.
text_cn: 于是，她的脚镣，要成为你有力的护卫，坚固的基础；她的枷锁，要成为你光荣的服饰。

text_en: You will wear her like a glorious robe, and put her on like a splendid crown.
text_cn: 她有黄金的美丽， 她的束缚有如紫红的织品。在她内，有生命的美丽；她的桎梏是有益的束缚。

text_en: If you are willing, my child, you can be disciplined, and if you apply yourself you will become clever.
text_cn: 你要穿上她，作你美丽的服装；戴上她，作你喜乐的冠冕。

text_en: If you love to listen you will gain knowledge, and if you pay attention you will become wise.
text_cn: 我儿，你若愿意，就可受教；你若专心，就会明智。

text_en: Stand in the company of the elders. Who is wise? Attach yourself to such a one.
text_cn: 你若爱听，就必得到智慧；你若侧耳静听，必成为智慧的人。

text_en: Be ready to listen to every godly discourse, and let no wise proverbs escape you.
text_cn: 你当常居于明智的长老之中，遇到有智慧的人，你应结识他。凡是天主的言语， 你都要喜欢恭听；对明哲的格言，不要轻忽。

text_en: If you see an intelligent person, rise early to visit him; let your foot wear out his doorstep.
text_cn: 假使你看见一个有智慧的人，你要及早前去拜访，你的脚要磨光他的门限。

text_en: Reflect on the statutes of the Lord, and meditate at all times on his commandments. It is he who will give insight to your mind, and your desire for wisdom will be granted.
text_cn: 你当默想上主的诫命，时常留心他的法令；如此，他必会坚固你的心，赐给你所希望的智慧。
